{{Top|leg}}
The '''lockout bypass''' was an interface designed to bypass most standard lock-out and security measures for the mass-produced terminals and locks that were found in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 1 to be able to equip this item.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''
